mechanism: Concurrent use of tricyclic antidepressants and MAOIs can precipitate serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and severe CNS toxicity due to inhibition of monoamine metabolism and increased norepinephrine/serotonin accumulation.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use together; allow minimum 14 days washout of MAOI before initiating nortriptyline, or 5 days washout of nortriptyline before starting MAOI.
